Home.eyebrow: WEDDING PLANNING, BUILT FOR INDIAN FAMILIES
Home.intro: One place for your events, tasks, guests, vendors, expenses and wedding website — built for Indian weddings and everyone helping you plan them.
Home.heroNote: One shared workspace. Every helping hand.
Home.family: Your family, on the same page
Home.problemBody: Tasks in chats. Guest lists in spreadsheets. Receipts on someone else’s phone. Bring all the little details into one shared space.
Home.scattered4Body: A checklist only one person can see
Home.unifiedBody: One home for the plans, people and details that make your wedding yours.
Home.benefit2: Know who is taking care of what
Home.benefit3: Bring both families into the plan
Home.eventsBody: From the first Mehendi designs to the last dance at reception, give every ceremony its own place in the plan.
Home.mehendiBody: An afternoon of henna, laughter and getting everyone together.
Home.haldiTitle: A little sunshine. A lot of joy.
Home.haldiBody: Bring the family together for a warm, joyful Haldi morning.
Home.sangeetBody: Family performances, favourite songs, and a dance floor full of memories.
Home.weddingEventTitle: The day it all comes together
Home.weddingEventBody: Keep the venue, ceremony details and responsibilities in one place.
Home.weddingEventTask1: Confirm the pandit and ceremony time
Home.receptionBody: Celebrate your new chapter with the people who mean the most.
Home.tasksLabel: A LITTLE CLARITY GOES A LONG WAY
Home.tasksTitle: Know exactly what needs to happen next.
Home.tasksBody: Create tasks, share responsibilities and set due dates. Less following up, more looking forward.
Home.taskFeature1: A clear owner for every task

Home.taskFeature2: The right details, in the right place
Home.taskFeature2Body: Keep notes, comments and documents with the task.
Home.teamLabel: PLANNED BY YOU. SUPPORTED BY YOUR PEOPLE.

Home.teamNote1: Manage the wedding and invite your team.
Home.teamNote2: Keep vendor details and payments organised.

Home.financeBody: Track selected vendors, documents, instalments and who paid. Know what’s paid and what’s still outstanding.
Home.financeNote: Contracts, invoices and receipts, right where you need them.
Home.siteBody: Create a wedding website that feels like you. Share your story, ceremonies and venue details with the people you love.
Home.siteFeature1: Choose a theme that feels right
Home.coupleAlt: An Indian bride and groom together in a palace courtyard
Home.howLabel: FROM “WE’RE GETTING MARRIED” TO WEDDING DAY
Home.howTitle: A little setup. A lot more together.

Home.step1Body: Add your names, wedding date and location.
Home.step2Body: Plan your ceremonies and invite family and organisers.
Home.step3Body: Organise tasks, guests, vendors and payments.
Home.step4Body: Share your wedding website and household invitations.
Home.privacyTitle: Your plans. Your people. Your permissions.
Home.privacyBody: Choose what you share with guests and what stays inside your wedding workspace.
Home.privacy1Body: Give organisers access to their events and keep finance access separate.
Home.privacy2Body: Contracts and receipts belong in your workspace, not on your public wedding page.
Home.privacy3Body: Each wedding has its own members, plans and information.
Home.ctaTitle: Your wedding has enough moving parts.

Home.footerNote: Made for Indian weddings. Built for everyone helping.
